questions.problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14005293/assets/8d940d158c631143a1fe7652a4fb83bf2f67f3fd4bbdbbc4a33643bd282b5028.png)

The Argand diagram above shows the roots of the cubic polynomial $f(x).$ Find $f(x)$ given that the coefficient of the cubic term is $4.$
questions.worked_solution:
From the diagram, we see that $f(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=0$ and ${x}_{2,3}=-1\pm 2\text{i}.$ Additionally, we're given that the coefficient of the cubic term is $a=4.$ Therefore, we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x) & =a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2})(x-{x}_{3}) \\  & =4(x-0)(x-(-1+2\text{i}))(x-(-1-2\text{i})) \\  & =4x(x-(-1+2\text{i}))(x-(-1-2\text{i}))\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}4x(x-(-1+2\text{i}))(x-(-1-2\text{i})) & = \\ 4x({x}^{2}-x(-1-2\text{i})-x(-1+2\text{i})+(-1+2\text{i})(-1-2\text{i})) & = \\ 4x({x}^{2}+2x+5) & = \\ 4{x}^{3}+8{x}^{2}+20x & .\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $f(x)=4{x}^{3}+8{x}^{2}+20x.$

questions.problem: The cubic polynomial $P(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}={x}_{2}=-2,{x}_{3}=5,$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $2.$ Find $P(x).$
questions.worked_solution:
Since our cubic polynomial has roots ${x}_{1}={x}_{2}=-2$ and ${x}_{3}=5,$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $a=2,$ we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2})(x-{x}_{3}) & =2(x-(-2))(x-(-2))(x-5) \\  & =2(x+2)(x+2)(x-5)\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}2(x+2)(x+2)(x-5) & =2({x}^{2}+4x+4)(x-5) \\  & =2({x}^{3}+4{x}^{2}-5{x}^{2}+4x-20x-20) \\  & =2({x}^{3}-{x}^{2}-16x-20) \\  & =2{x}^{3}-2{x}^{2}-32x-40.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $P(x)=2{x}^{3}-2{x}^{2}-32x-40.$

questions.worked_solution:
Since our cubic polynomial has roots ${x}_{1}=3,$ ${x}_{2}=3,$ and ${x}_{3}=-2,$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $a=5,$ we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2})(x-{x}_{3}) & =5(x-3)(x-3)(x-(-2)) \\  & =5(x-3)(x-3)(x+2)\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}5(x-3)(x-3)(x+2) & =5({x}^{2}-6x+9)(x+2) \\  & =5({x}^{3}+2{x}^{2}-6{x}^{2}-12x+9x+18) \\  & =5({x}^{3}-4{x}^{2}-3x+18) \\  & =5{x}^{3}-20{x}^{2}-15x+90.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $P(x)=5{x}^{3}-20{x}^{2}-15x+90.$

questions.problem:
The cubic polynomial $f(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=-2,{x}_{2,3}=\pm 4\text{i},$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $3.$ Find $f(x).$

$f(x)=$
{{field-1}}${x}^{3}\,+$
{{field-2}}${x}^{2}\,+$
{{field-3}}$x\,+$
{{field-4}}
questions.worked_solution:
Since $f(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=-2$ and ${x}_{2,3}=\pm 4\text{i},$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $a=3,$ we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x) & =a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2})(x-{x}_{3}) \\  & =3(x-(-2))(x-4\text{i})(x-(-4\text{i})) \\  & =3(x+2)(x-4\text{i})(x+4\text{i})\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}3(x+2)(x-4\text{i})(x+4\text{i}) & = \\ 3(x+2)({x}^{2}-(4\text{i})^{2}) & = \\ 3(x+2)({x}^{2}+16) & = \\ 3({x}^{3}+2{x}^{2}+16x+32) & = \\ 3{x}^{3}+6{x}^{2}+48x+96 & .\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $f(x)=3{x}^{3}+6{x}^{2}+48x+96.$

questions.worked_solution:
Since $f(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=6$ and ${x}_{2,3}=\pm 3\text{i},$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $a=-4,$ we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x) & =a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2})(x-{x}_{3}) \\  & =-4(x-6)(x-3\text{i})(x-(-3\text{i})) \\  & =-4(x-6)(x-3\text{i})(x+3\text{i})\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}-4(x-6)(x-3\text{i})(x+3\text{i}) & = \\ -4(x-6)({x}^{2}-x(-3\text{i})-x(3\text{i})+(3\text{i})(-3\text{i})) & = \\ -4(x-6)({x}^{2}+9) & = \\ -4({x}^{3}-6{x}^{2}+9x-54) & = \\ -4{x}^{3}+24{x}^{2}-36x+216.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $f(x)=-4{x}^{3}+24{x}^{2}-36x+216.$
